name: Amasa (Ephraimite)
title: Leader in Ephraim who helped the captives
summary: Amasa, son of Hadlai, was one of the leaders in Ephraim who rose up against taking the captives from Judah into slavery. They clothed and cared for the naked and exhausted captives and brought them back.

keyEvents.title: Takes care of the captives from Judah
keyEvents.description: Amasa and other Ephraimite leaders opposed making the Judeans slaves, and instead provided clothing, food, and care to the exhausted captives.
